goal: See that a gap has a shape and the piece that fits it has the same shape (and turn), not the same colour; put a whole picture together from its pieces.
cover: Owl proudly holds up her crayon painting of a little cottage with a red triangular roof, but a triangle-shaped piece is missing from the roof; Squirrel beside her offers a red square paper piece, and on the grass lie a red triangle piece and a green circle piece, while small Hedgehog peeks in, curious, from the right.
